interpretation.clocks: performance.now intervals within each process; Date.now ledger semantics unchanged; client and server monotonic origins must not be subtracted
interpretation.hooks: FSREQPROMISE before/after bracket callback execution, not physical completion or Promise continuation; init-to-before contains unresolved worker/OS/delivery components
interpretation.eventLoop: process-wide overlapping activity; ELU active includes synchronous native calls and preemption, not CPU; histogram covers setup GET + POSTs + client startup/exit, not installer/shutdown
interpretation.spans: >=0.5ms synchronous callback wall intervals; union overlap is a lower bound; short callbacks and work outside before/after are omitted
interpretation.profiling: leaf counts are exclusive statistical samples; inclusiveOccurrences count stack occurrences (including recursive duplicates), overlap and must not be summed or converted to disjoint percentages
interpretation.syscall: -T is traced syscall elapsed time, includes tracing/scheduling overhead, excludes libuv queue/delivery; realtime ordering bridge is approximate, no Contact syscall-to-request join
interpretation.unknown: observer-off native commits, calls, deadlines and Page elapsed are unobserved (null), never zero; HTTP headers/receipt still observed
interpretation.exploratory: first matrix omitted supervisor TMPDIR, one fewer inspected ancestor per operation; retained separately and excluded from primary comparisons; first exploratory traces lacked guard-file classification
interpretation.scope: diagnostic investigation, not production reliability/security qualification

environment.topology: fresh server worker per window; supervised separate HTTP client; serial windows; no other test suite
environment.instrumentation: existing HTTP diagnostics + FSREQPROMISE/native-gap/Clear; scheduling adds 10ms monitorEventLoopDelay, ELU snapshots and >=0.5ms callback spans
